reason: My first question is always whether it's actually tested, and here the lab is named and the report is on the page, so I can check it myself. Sachets mean no bottle going into the drawer, and $24.99 is an easy impulse buy for one box to try.
objection: I've got a drawer of half-used bottles. I'd want to open the lab report and see that it matches the label before I trust it, and I'm not sure I'd actually finish 30 days.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page was missing, generic, or didn't name a real lab, I'd skip it.
